blurb: Beachside Helicopters offers daily helicopter tours over the Space Coast and surrounding areas from Merritt Island Airport. Tours are flown in a Robinson R44 Clipper II amphibious helicopter with air conditioning. They are the only company in the area legally allowed to fly tours over water.
